signature: SUBROUTINE DGESC2( N, A, LDA, RHS, IPIV, JPIV, SCALE )

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the LU part of the factorization of the n-by-n matrix A computed by DGETC2: $A = P \, L \, U \, Q$

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1, N)$.

params.name: RHS
params.reference: On entry, the right hand side vector b. On exit, the solution vector X.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices; for $1 \le i \le N$, row i of the matrix has been interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.

params.name: JPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices; for $1 \le j \le N$, column j of the matrix has been interchanged with column `JPIV(j)`.

params.name: scale
params.reference: On exit, `SCALE` contains the scale factor. `SCALE` is chosen $0 \le \mathrm{SCALE} \le 1$ to prevent overflow in the solution.
